Applying a tovar theme backs up your settings before it changes anything.
Only one tovar theme is active at a time.
Mario first appeared in Donkey Kong (1981), where he was called Jumpman.
The Legend of Zelda was one of the first console games to save with a battery.
Pikachu's name mixes Japanese sounds: pika (sparkle) and chu (squeak).
In the first Metroid, only fast players learned Samus was a woman.
Kirby was created by Masahiro Sakurai, the same person who directs Smash.
Donkey Kong Country made SNES graphics look 3D with pre-rendered models.
Star Fox had a Super FX chip inside the cartridge to draw its 3D polygons.
Sonic is blue to match the color of Sega's logo.
Combos in Street Fighter II began as a glitch the team decided to keep.
Legend says Final Fantasy got its name because it might be its creator's last game.
Marth and Roy in Melee helped bring Fire Emblem to the West for the first time.
Animal Crossing began on the Nintendo 64, released only in Japan in 2001.
Snake joined Smash in Brawl because Hideo Kojima asked Sakurai to add him.
EarthBound's US release came in an oversized box with a strategy guide.
Pac-Man's shape was inspired by a pizza with one slice missing.
